definitions.explanation: To physically or abstractly occupy a place, position, or role.

definitions.gloss: to account for; to make up
definitions.explanation: To constitute a certain proportion or percentage of a whole.

examples.japanese: {重要|じゅうよう}な{位置|いち}を{占|し}める。
この{産業|さんぎょう}は{経済|けいざい}の{中|なか}で{大|おお}きな{割合|わりあい}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: This industry occupies a large share of the economy.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{私|わたし}の{人生|じんせい}で{特別|とくべつ}な{場所|ばしょ}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: She holds a special place in my life.

examples.japanese: {女性|じょせい}が{全体|ぜんたい}の60%を{占|し}める。
examples.english: Women account for 60% of the total.

examples.japanese: {食費|しょくひ}が{支出|ししゅつ}の{大半|たいはん}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: Food costs make up the majority of the expenditure.

examples.japanese: {輸出|ゆしゅつ}に{占|し}める{製造業|せいぞうぎょう}の{割合|わりあい}は{年々|ねんねん}{減少|げんしょう}している。
examples.english: The proportion of manufacturing in exports is decreasing year by year.

notes:
This is a different word from {閉|し}める (to close) and {締|し}める (to tighten). Sense 2, expressing proportions and percentages, is extremely common in statistics, reports, and news.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{割合|わりあい}を{占|し}める: to account for a share
・{位置|いち}を{占|し}める: to hold a position
・〜%を{占|し}める: to account for ~%
・{大半|たいはん}を{占|し}める: to make up the majority
